# Email template: Welcome / account created

Greets the new user by name and lists three short next steps before the sign-in button.

Plain TypeScript functions that return a complete HTML email (inline styles, tables, Arabic and English), so any back end can send it. Two files: `welcome.email.ts` and the shared `email-layout.ts`. Replace the sample values with real data and keep escaping it as the functions do.

## welcome.email.ts

```ts
import {
  EMAIL_FONT,
  type EmailLang,
  emailButton,
  emailDocument,
  emailHeading,
  emailParagraph,
  emailStart,
  escapeHtml,
} from './email-layout';

export interface WelcomeEmailData {
  /** Name of the new user, already in the language of the message. */
  userName: string;
  /** Link to the sign-in page. */
  signInUrl: string;
}

const DEFAULTS: Record<EmailLang, WelcomeEmailData> = {
  en: { userName: 'Fahad Al-Otaibi', signInUrl: 'https://referrals.example.org/sign-in' },
  ar: { userName: 'فهد العتيبي', signInUrl: 'https://referrals.example.org/sign-in' },
};

/** Welcome / account created email: greeting by name, three short next steps and a button. */
export function welcomeEmail(lang: EmailLang, data: Partial<WelcomeEmailData> = {}): string {
  const { userName, signInUrl } = { ...DEFAULTS[lang], ...data };
  const name = escapeHtml(userName);
  const start = emailStart(lang);

  const t =
    lang === 'ar'
      ? {
          title: 'تم إنشاء حسابك',
          preheader: 'تم إنشاء حسابك في نظام إدارة الإحالات الطبية وتحويل المرضى. إليك الخطوات التالية.',
          heading: `مرحبًا بك، ${name}`,
          intro: 'تم إنشاء حسابك في نظام إدارة الإحالات الطبية وتحويل المرضى بنجاح. للبدء، أكمل الخطوات التالية:',
          steps: [
            { title: 'سجّل الدخول', text: 'استخدم اسم المستخدم وكلمة المرور المؤقتة التي استلمتها.' },
            { title: 'غيّر كلمة المرور', text: 'سيُطلب منك اختيار كلمة مرور جديدة عند أول دخول.' },
            { title: 'أكمل ملفك الشخصي', text: 'راجع بياناتك وجهة عملك حتى تصلك الطلبات الصحيحة.' },
          ],
          button: 'تسجيل الدخول إلى النظام',
          help: 'إذا احتجت إلى مساعدة، تواصل مع الدعم الفني من صفحة «الدعم» داخل النظام.',
        }
      : {
          title: 'Your account has been created',
          preheader: 'Your account in the Medical Referrals and Patient Transfer System is ready. Here are your next steps.',
          heading: `Welcome, ${name}`,
          intro: 'Your account in the Medical Referrals and Patient Transfer System has been created. To get started, complete these steps:',
          steps: [
            { title: 'Sign in', text: 'Use your user name and the temporary password you received.' },
            { title: 'Change your password', text: 'You will be asked to choose a new password at your first sign-in.' },
            { title: 'Complete your profile', text: 'Review your details and your facility so the right requests reach you.' },
          ],
          button: 'Sign in to the system',
          help: 'If you need help, contact technical support from the Support page inside the system.',
        };

  // Numbered steps as table rows: number in a dark green cell, text beside it.
  const stepRows = t.steps
    .map(
      (step, index) => `                <tr>
                  <td width="32" valign="top" style="padding:0 0 16px;">
                    <table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0">
                      <tr>
                        <td width="32" height="32" align="center" valign="middle" bgcolor="#29504D" style="width:32px; height:32px; background-color:#29504D; border-radius:16px; font-family:${EMAIL_FONT}; font-size:15px; line-height:32px; font-weight:700; color:#FFFFFF;">${index + 1}</td>
                      </tr>
                    </table>
                  </td>
                  <td width="12" style="width:12px; font-size:0; line-height:0;">&nbsp;</td>
                  <td valign="top" style="padding:3px 0 16px; font-family:${EMAIL_FONT}; font-size:15px; line-height:24px; color:#4C5A61; text-align:${start};">
                    <strong style="color:#111B21;">${step.title}</strong><br>${step.text}
                  </td>
                </tr>`,
    )
    .join('\n');

  return emailDocument({
    lang,
    title: t.title,
    preheader: t.preheader,
    body: [
      emailHeading(lang, t.heading),
      emailParagraph(lang, t.intro),
      `              <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="margin:8px 0 8px;">
${stepRows}
              </table>`,
      emailButton(lang, t.button, signInUrl),
      emailParagraph(lang, t.help, true),
    ],
  });
}
```

## email-layout.ts

```ts
/**
 * Shared building blocks of the email templates.
 *
 * Emails are not Angular components: every function here returns a string of
 * HTML written for email clients — table layout, inline styles only, literal
 * hex colours (clients do not support CSS variables), no JavaScript, no
 * external CSS and no remote images. The header uses a text wordmark instead
 * of a logo file, so nothing is blocked when images are turned off.
 *
 * Brand colours: light green #00A05A, dark green #29504D, grey #B2BEC4,
 * text #111B21, muted text #4C5A61, page background #F1F4F5.
 */

export type EmailLang = 'en' | 'ar';

/** 'Saudi MOD' is only a hint: clients fall back to the system fonts after it. */
export const EMAIL_FONT = "'Saudi MOD', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif";

const SHELL = {
  en: {
    sender: 'This message was sent by the Medical Referrals and Patient Transfer System, Organization name.',
    noReply: 'This is an automated message. Please do not reply to it.',
    copyright: '© Organization name 2026. All rights reserved.',
  },
  ar: {
    sender: 'أُرسلت هذه الرسالة من نظام إدارة الإحالات الطبية وتحويل المرضى، اسم الجهة.',
    noReply: 'هذه رسالة آلية، يُرجى عدم الرد عليها.',
    copyright: '© اسم الجهة 2026. جميع الحقوق محفوظة.',
  },
} as const;

/** Escapes a value before it is placed in the HTML (names, numbers, URLs). */
export function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

/**
 * Returns the URL when it is an http(s) or mailto link, otherwise '#'. Keeps
 * `javascript:` and other schemes out of the links of an email.
 */
export function safeEmailUrl(url: string): string {
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(url.trim()) ? url.trim() : '#';
}

/** Start side of the text for the language: left in English, right in Arabic. */
export function emailStart(lang: EmailLang): 'left' | 'right' {
  return lang === 'ar' ? 'right' : 'left';
}

/**
 * Title of the message (one per email). `text` is inserted as HTML: pass
 * fixed copy, and run any value that comes from data through `escapeHtml`
 * first (as the templates in this folder do).
 */
export function emailHeading(lang: EmailLang, text: string): string {
  return `              <h1 style="margin:0 0 16px; font-family:${EMAIL_FONT}; font-size:24px; line-height:32px; font-weight:700; color:#111B21; text-align:${emailStart(lang)};">${text}</h1>`;
}

/**
 * Body paragraph. `muted` is for secondary notes. `text` is inserted as HTML
 * (it may contain inline tags): escape data values with `escapeHtml` first.
 */
export function emailParagraph(lang: EmailLang, text: string, muted = false): string {
  const size = muted ? 'font-size:14px; line-height:22px; color:#4C5A61;' : 'font-size:16px; line-height:26px; color:#111B21;';
  return `              <p style="margin:0 0 16px; font-family:${EMAIL_FONT}; ${size} text-align:${emailStart(lang)};">${text}</p>`;
}

/**
 * Bulletproof button: the colour is on the table cell, so the button keeps
 * its shape in clients that ignore padding or backgrounds on links.
 * White on dark green keeps the label above the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
 */
export function emailButton(lang: EmailLang, label: string, url: string): string {
  return `              <table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" align="${emailStart(lang)}" style="margin:8px 0 24px;">
                <tr>
                  <td align="center" bgcolor="#29504D" style="background-color:#29504D; border-radius:6px;">
                    <a href="${escapeHtml(safeEmailUrl(url))}" target="_blank" style="display:inline-block; padding:14px 28px; font-family:${EMAIL_FONT}; font-size:16px; line-height:20px; font-weight:700; color:#FFFFFF; text-decoration:none; border-radius:6px;">${label}</a>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </table>
              <div style="clear:both; height:0; font-size:0; line-height:0;">&nbsp;</div>`;
}

/** Thin grey rule between parts of the body. */
export function emailDivider(): string {
  return `              <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0">
                <tr>
                  <td style="padding:8px 0 24px;"><div style="height:1px; font-size:0; line-height:0; background-color:#B2BEC4;">&nbsp;</div></td>
                </tr>
              </table>`;
}

export interface EmailDocument {
  lang: EmailLang;
  /** Subject-like title of the document (`<title>`). Escaped by `emailDocument`. */
  title: string;
  /** Plain-text preview shown by the mail client next to the subject. Inserted as HTML: escape data values. */
  preheader: string;
  /** Body blocks (built with the helpers above), joined with new lines. */
  body: string[];
}

/** Wraps the body blocks in the complete HTML document: header band, body, footer. */
export function emailDocument({ lang, title, preheader, body }: EmailDocument): string {
  const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  const start = emailStart(lang);
  const t = SHELL[lang];

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="x-apple-disable-message-reformatting">
  <meta name="format-detection" content="telephone=no, date=no, address=no, email=no">
  <title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title>
</head>
<body style="margin:0; padding:0; background-color:#F1F4F5;">
  <!-- Preheader: plain text shown in the inbox preview, hidden in the message. -->
  <div style="display:none; max-height:0; max-width:0; overflow:hidden; opacity:0; font-size:1px; line-height:1px; color:#F1F4F5;">${preheader}</div>

  <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" dir="${dir}" style="background-color:#F1F4F5;">
    <tr>
      <td align="center" style="padding:24px 12px;">
        <table role="presentation" width="600" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" dir="${dir}" style="width:100%; max-width:600px; background-color:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #B2BEC4;">
          <!-- Header band: text wordmark, no image -->
          <tr>
            <td align="${start}" bgcolor="#29504D" style="padding:20px 32px; background-color:#29504D; border-bottom:4px solid #00A05A; font-family:${EMAIL_FONT}; font-size:18px; line-height:26px; font-weight:700; color:#FFFFFF; text-align:${start};">
              <span lang="en" dir="ltr">Organization name</span>
              <span style="color:#B2BEC4; font-weight:400;">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span>
              <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">اسم الجهة</span>
            </td>
          </tr>
          <!-- Body -->
          <tr>
            <td align="${start}" style="padding:32px 32px 16px; text-align:${start};">
${body.join('\n')}
            </td>
          </tr>
          <!-- Footer -->
          <tr>
            <td align="${start}" bgcolor="#F1F4F5" style="padding:20px 32px; background-color:#F1F4F5; border-top:1px solid #B2BEC4; font-family:${EMAIL_FONT}; font-size:13px; line-height:20px; color:#4C5A61; text-align:${start};">
              <p style="margin:0 0 4px;">${t.sender}</p>
              <p style="margin:0 0 4px;">${t.noReply}</p>
              <p style="margin:0;">${t.copyright}</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </table>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </table>
</body>
</html>
`;
}
```
